data_reuse: Same already examined BTC history. Neither chronological evaluation nor walk-forward is a blind holdout. All candidate outcomes must be retained. No claim of a proven edge.

rules.breakout20: Enter Close>SMA200 and Close>prior High20; exit Close<SMA200 or Close<prior Low10.
rules.breakout55: Enter Close>SMA200 and Close>prior High55; exit Close<SMA200 or Close<prior Low20.
rules.sma200_band: Enter Close>1.01*SMA200; exit Close<0.99*SMA200. State conditions, not crossing events.
rules.sma50_200: Enter SMA50>SMA200; exit SMA50<SMA200. State conditions.
rules.momentum90: Enter Close>Close[t-90]; exit Close<Close[t-90]. State conditions.
rules.rsi2_pullback: Enter Close>SMA200 and simple rolling-2 RSI<10; exit Close>SMA5 or Close<SMA200 or after 10 held daily bars. Rolling arithmetic RSI, not Wilder RSI.
rules.bollinger20: Enter Close<SMA20-2*population_std20; exit Close>=SMA20 or after 20 held daily bars. No trend filter.
rules.macd_trend: EMA spans 12/26, adjust=False, signal EMA9; enter MACD>signal and Close>SMA200; exit MACD<signal or Close<SMA200. State conditions.

sizing.fixed50: Spend 50% of available cash inclusive of entry fee.
sizing.vol15_cap50: Spend min(0.5,0.15/realized_vol60) of cash at entry; sample std of 60 completed daily simple returns * sqrt(365.25). Zero volatility uses 50%. No rebalancing. 15% is a sizing reference, not promised portfolio volatility or a stop-loss.

execution: Close signal at t, fill open at t+1; one long position or cash; no leverage/shorts. Inclusive entry fee, adverse slippage each side. Forced liquidation at final close. 200 prior candles warmup. Weight may drift above entry allocation; no intraday stop. Cash yield zero.
cost_note: Hypothetical bps per side, not account fee quotes. Operating expense externally deducted at period end; not paid out of the trading ledger. Taxes excluded. Benchmark external expense assumed zero; both transaction-only and operating-adjusted comparisons reported.
selection: Choose using train only: require positive after-operating profit and max close drawdown<=35% under BOTH base and stress, at least 10 completed trades. Rank by stress annualized return after external operating expense / max(stress drawdown,1 percentage point); ties lexical candidate id. If none eligible select cash. Never select by 2024-2026 results.
walk_forward: For each year 2022..2026 choose using only 2020 through prior Dec31 under the same screen. Apply chosen rules for the next year (2026 through Oct15). Liquidate/reset positions annually, carrying end equity less prorated operating expense. Separately simulate base and stress ledgers; cash fallback still pays the research bot operating assumption. This is historical causal replay, not new observations.
candidate_screen: Positive profit after operating expense in full, validation and recent windows under both base and stress; full drawdown<=35% both; >=20 full trades and >=5 validation trades. Passing permits consideration for paper observation only. Does not change train-only selection.
multiplicity: 16 predefined candidates. Exploratory common-date circular-block bootstrap of centered daily returns versus buy_hold50 and cash for base evaluation period; maximum mean across all 16, 2000 resamples, seed 20261016, block lengths 10,30,60. Arithmetic daily excess returns, transaction costs only. Conditional diagnostic of this family, not correction for prior studies or a profit proof.
stop: Run this fixed matrix once; retain failures; no parameter expansion or rule tuning in response to profitability. Correct demonstrated code defects and label reruns.
